summary.text: Sophia Warren is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives from District 124 and the Democratic candidate for the Maine State Senate, District 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is not running for re-election to the House in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Sophia Warren was born in Portland, Maine, lives in Scarborough, and earned a bachelor's degree in international relations from Brandeis University in 2019.
Her career experience includes work as a legal assistant with Irwin & Morris, a research assistant, a teaching assistant and a legislative intern with the office of U.S. Senator Angus King.
She has been affiliated with Seeds of Peace and the Scarborough Land Trust.
Ballotpedia lists her tenure in the Maine House as beginning in 2020, and her current term ends on December 1, 2026.
She was assigned to the Labor and Housing Committee in 2021-2022 and to the Energy, Utilities and Technology Committee in 2023-2024.
In 2021, she switched her party affiliation from independent to Democrat, saying the partisan system makes it difficult for independents to pass legislation.
